jobs.title: EMPTY STORAGE PLOT
jobs.design: EMPTY WOOD-SYMBOL STORAGE PAD. Exactly ZERO physical stored objects. One centered flat painted log-segment pictogram: medium golden-brown bark, pale golden cut-end circle facing the pad FRONT edge, simple darker outline. The log glyph is a FLAT illustration on the ground plane with no physical thickness or cast shadow, about one-third the pad width. At FRONT0 its pale circular cut-end is toward the nearest front edge, with bark extending toward the rear. The entire pictogram must turn sideways and upside-down with the pad through the eight views. The source shows this marked empty pad; do not erase the symbol or create a blank platform. Use the third reference for title/view label layout only, never add its actual rope bundle.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished HAVENLINE ground-plot 360-degree concept turnaround sheet. Source gameplay crops are the authority for physical footprint, borders, colors and pictograms. Prior Havenline resource art is for stock-item materials only. Flat plot decals stay FLAT and nearly ground-flush, no thick base, podium, wood floor, fencing, pillars, rope, snowy mound or building. Clean dark navy studio floor/background, no scene or characters. Landscape sheet, clearly readable heading, exactlyFOURcolumns byTWOrows, equal panels, generous margins. Same whole plot and same attached graphics/stock rotated clockwise about vertical axis; fixed orthographic-like camera35degrees above ground so the top remains visible. TOP ROW: FRONT0°, FRONT RIGHT45°, RIGHT90°, REAR RIGHT135°. BOTTOM ROW: REAR180°, REAR LEFT225°, LEFT270°, FRONT LEFT315°. Distinct opposite and diagonal directions. At0front edge horizontal nearest viewer. At45front edge slopes down-left-to-right and right edge is visible, while225has the opposite back face in the same diagonal.135and315 use the opposite diagonal. All artwork and cost symbols are printed flat ON THE GROUND PLANE and rotate physically with the same plot; in rear180 the artwork is upside down to the camera, and90/270 it is sideways. Never redraw glyphs to face the camera in every view. Panel view labels remain upright outside the asset. Uniform object scale and fixed soft studio lighting. Rounded polished readable game-resource materials; no photographic pores or gritty medieval styling. Small footer '360° CONCEPT TURNAROUND'. No watermark or copied game UI.

Exact sheet title: HAVENLINE / EMPTY STORAGE PLOT. Match the prior resource turnaround's clean navy 4x2 title/view-label layout; however the source gameplay pad geometry is the authority. Source photos are references, not edit targets; no phone UI, source branding, costs, characters, trees or machinery appear in the output.

COMMON PAD DESIGN: A thin continuous pale tan/cream rounded-rectangle outline surrounds one solid dark warm gray-brown flat field. Same footprint in every panel, width1.35 times front-to-back depth, softly rounded corners. The pad is almost zero-thickness, a ground decal with no raised foundation, bevel-wall, planks, posts, rails, surrounding ropes, snow, curb or stone ring. The centered resource pictogram is flat painted 2D art fixed to the top surface, never a physical resource and never billboarded. Leave generous visible dark border between stock and perimeter. All8 panels show exactly the same pad, stock and anchored pictogram rotating together. The asset is isolated on navy background, no warm rectangular terrain slab underneath.

At FRONT0 its pale circular cut-end is toward the nearest front edge, with bark extending toward the rear. The entire pictogram must turn sideways and upside-down with the pad through the eight views. The source shows this marked empty pad; do not erase the symbol or create a blank platform. For a directional glyph whose front end points to the pad FRONT edge: FRONT0 shows that end nearest the bottom, FRONT RIGHT45 nearest lowerLEFT, RIGHT90 points imageLEFT, REAR RIGHT135 points far upperLEFT, REAR180 upside down pointing away towardtop, REAR LEFT225 far upperRIGHT, LEFT270 points imageRIGHT, FRONT LEFT315 nearer lowerRIGHT. Preserve the pad as a flat painted storage marking with a continuous tan outline, never a purchase pad with broken white corners. No price, capacity, fill meter or extraneous text. Exact footer 360° CONCEPT TURNAROUND.

jobs.title: WOOD STORAGE
jobs.design: STOCKED WOOD PAD. Centered painted log pictogram, the same simple flat golden-brown log icon as the source. Place exactly ONE resource bundle consisting of exactly THREE chunky logs (two lower logs and one top log) on the rear half of the pad, with its long axis LEFT-to-RIGHT at FRONT0. Match the prior approved wood resource reference's broad caramel bark planes, golden circular endgrain and one existing tan bundle tie. That small tie belongs only to the stock item, not the pad; add no rope perimeter. Fixed front rope knot stays on the FRONT-facing broad side of the log bundle; rear broad side has no knot. Keep exactly3logs and1tie in all views. Position bundle far enough toward rear that a portion of centered painted log icon and continuous pad perimeter remain readable. jobs.title: MEAT STORAGE
jobs.design: STOCKED GENERIC MEAT PAD. One centered FLAT painted red steak pictogram with cream edge; a small pale inner mark makes its orientation unambiguous. Physical stock is exactly TWO stacks, each exactly THREE flat red steak portions from the prior approved generic meat reference, for SIX total portions. Put the two stacks side-by-side LEFT-to-RIGHT, slightly toward the rear half of the same pad. Both stacks have the same arrangement and height; do not multiply, remove or rearrange portions between views. Each steak is a thick rounded asymmetric red portion with cream upper rim and broad pale muscle streaks; clean sculpted game material, no wet blood, bone or gore. Lower three layers clearly separated on sidewalls. The physical steaks' long axes lie left-right at FRONT0; their small notches are fixed toward the FRONT-RIGHT of each piece, so those landmarks rotate correctly and become hidden atrear. Paint icon remains centered, can be partly occluded bystock, but does not move to an edge to stayvisible. Fixed stock count in every view. This is illustrative stocking, not capacity or species-drop proof.
